map.坐位体前屈是衡量身体柔韧性的经典测试项目。输入性别、年龄和测试成绩（cm），自动: The sit-and-reach test is a classic measure of body flexibility. Enter sex, age, and the measured result (cm) to automatically compute the percentile and rating, based on the National Physical Fitness Standard reference data.
map.百分等级：输入性别、年龄与成绩，得百分等级与评级。: Percentile: enter sex, age, and result to get the percentile and rating.
map.年龄对照：同成绩在不同年龄段等级不同，便于纵向比较。: Age reference: the same result maps to different grades across age groups, which helps longitudinal comparison.
map.进步跟踪：前后两次测试对比百分等级，量化训练成效。: Progress tracking: compare percentiles across two tests to quantify training gains.
map.：女、25 岁、坐位体前屈 22cm，对照标准百分等级约 80、评级「优秀」；半: : a 25-year-old woman with a 22 cm sit-and-reach scores around the 80th percentile, rated "excellent"; six months later at 26 cm she rises to about the 90th percentile.
map.标准来源是什么？: What Is the Source of the Standard?
map.依据国民体质监测相关标准，按性别与年龄分组。: Based on national physical fitness monitoring standards, grouped by sex and age.
